{{Conjecture|legends}}
[[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Scout/Legends|scouts]] led an '''expedition''' to the [[Serianan system/Legends|Serianan system]] to follow up on the finds made by [[Korren Starchaser]] during a previous [[Serias expedition|expedition]]. There, they discovered that a team of [[Alien/Legends|alien]] [[Archaeology/Legends|xenoarchaeologists]] had arrived in-system, as well as teams of prospectors.

{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}
The New Republic scouts teamed up with the aliens to protect their data from the prospectors.
